changelog:
Legacy device & browser overhaul. Minimum stays Android 5, targetSdk 36 preserved. Introduces standalone GeckoView browser engine package—modern rendering for old hardware without touching system WebView. Ships as separate APK; switch engines in-app. Ideal for Echo Show, Facebook Portal, old tablets with frozen browsers. Path: Settings → Web Browsing → Render Engine → GeckoView. arm64 and armv7 builds available; ADB permission assist for Android 8 and below.

German language added. UI auto-switches when system language set to German.

User feedback addressed: #83 Echo Show 5 startup resilience hardened; #82 Sendspin device names customizable; #81 Browser Display dark mode sync; #80 follow-up mode stop-word logic; #79 browser toggle freeze; #78 Facebook Portal device admin permission via ADB.

Wake & microphone stability: permission denial no longer crashes, unstarted mic reads safely, TensorFlow init failures auto-downgrade, Android 5/6 unsupported libs stop retry loops, wake engine failure falls back to null detector. Service survives old hardware gracefully.

Stop-word detection now CPU-efficient—runs only during alarms or active voice sessions, idle standby skips it. Edge lighting fixed to fill bottom navigation bar. Sendspin device name changes trigger instant session restart. Browser Display show/hide chain stabilized.
